mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS below 2.0%) signals accommodative monetary policy that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 2.0%, or Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window falls below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: When year-over-year CPIAUCSL exceeds 3.5%, it indicates persistent inflation requiring aggressive monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL YoY exceeds 3.5%, or Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window falls below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST below 1250.0) and rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE above 3.8%) signals deteriorating consumer demand and labor market stress, predicting negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal (HOUST < 1250.0 and UNRATE > 3.8%) fails to predict negative returns in more than 55% of instances, or interaction term Rank IC over 3 years falls below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: In high-employment growth regimes (PAYEMS growth > 0.5% monthly), strong labor market conditions support consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when PAYEMS growth exceeds 0.5% monthly, or Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window falls below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: Rising industrial production (INDPRO above 108.0) indicates expanding manufacturing output and economic activity, supporting corporate profits and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO is above 108.0, or Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window falls below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) fall below 1250.0 thousand units, it signals immediate weakness in the housing market and consumer demand, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when HOUST is below 1250.0, or Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window falls below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous decline in FEDFUNDS and rise in CPIAUCSL above 2.5% indicates monetary policy response to inflation, triggering recession risks that predict negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal (FEDFUNDS decline and CPIAUCSL > 2.5%) fails to predict negative returns in more than 55% of instances, or interaction term Rank IC over 3 years falls below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansion regimes (GDPC1 annual growth > 2.0%), strong economic momentum supports sustained corporate earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when GDPC1 annual growth exceeds 2.0%, or Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window falls below 0.02.
